characters.name: WORKER
characters.card: a young American full-time worker. Faded dusty-blue button-up work shirt with sleeves rolled to the elbow, worn untucked; khaki chino trousers; plain brown belt; grey sneakers; a navy canvas messenger bag on the character's own right hip, strap across the chest; a lanyard with a blank white ID card. No logos and no writing on any clothing.

characters.name: PAY
characters.card: a runner who stands for pay, the same height as WORKER. Muted sage-green zip tracksuit jacket and matching trousers, white sneakers, a white sweatband on the character's own left wrist; carries a rolled-up paycheck like a relay baton in the character's own right hand. No writing on clothing.

characters.name: RENT
characters.card: a runner who stands for rent, the same height as WORKER. Muted burnt-orange tracksuit jacket, dark grey trousers, orange sneakers, a small brick-red backpack shaped like a little house on the back. No writing on clothing.
